<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Courier New',monospace">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="nl-bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#031b14"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#010a08"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="nl-line" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0affc0" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#0affc0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0affc0" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <style>
      .nl-flat{stroke:#0affc0;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;opacity:0.35}
      .nl-beat{stroke:#0affc0;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:900;stroke-dashoffset:900;animation:nlsweep 4s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #0affc0)}
      @keyframes nlsweep{0%{stroke-dashoffset:900}70%{stroke-dashoffset:0}100%{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
      .nl-word{fill:#0affc0;letter-spacing:6px;font-weight:700}
      .nl-tag{fill:#7fd9c4;letter-spacing:2px}
    </style>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#nl-bg)"/>
  <rect x="16" y="16" width="608" height="328" fill="none" stroke="#0affc0" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- dead flatline, ever-present underneath -->
  <path class="nl-flat" d="M40,180 L600,180"/>

  <!-- the resurrection beat, sweeping left to right forever -->
  <path class="nl-beat" d="M40,180 L220,180 L245,120 L270,240 L295,60 L320,180 L360,180 L380,150 L400,180 L600,180"/>

  <circle cx="600" cy="180" r="5" fill="#0affc0">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <text x="320" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="46" class="nl-word">NEXTLIFE™</text>
  <text x="320" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" class="nl-tag">RESURRECTION ASSURANCE</text>
  <text x="320" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-style="italic" fill="#4f7d70">"Because dying is not an excuse to stop paying."</text>

  <g font-size="10" fill="#3d6459">
    <text x="320" y="330" text-anchor="middle">PREMIUMS CONTINUE POSTHUMOUSLY · UNDERWRITTEN BY THE ARCHITECT MUTUAL TRUST</text>
  </g>
</svg>
description: Title card for the NextLife™ Resurrection Assurance commercial.
name: NextLife™ — Logo
